name: Alexa’s Input (AI)
bio: Alexa’s Input is a podcast about how technology actually moves forward. Hosted by Alexa Griffith, it features conversations with engineers, founders, CEOs, and leaders shaping today’s tech landscape. Each episode digs into the decisions behind the systems — what’s being built, what’s being questioned, and why it matters now.

attention.bio: Attention Deficit is a weekly AI news show from two engineers who build with this stuff all day. Taylor Dolezal (Dosu) and Alexa Griffith (Red Hat) cover agents, infrastructure, and the messy reality between demo and production.

episodes.title: Attention Deficit Ep. 8 – GPT-6 Luna vs Sol. Can a harness close the gap?
episodes.description: Alexa Griffith and Taylor Dolezal discuss agent harness costs, Google’s Agent Substrate, and voice AI.

episodes.title: Attention Deficit Ep. 7 – Be Like a Data Center
episodes.description: Rogue agents, virtual cells, AI search, and what students say about the AI bubble.

episodes.title: Attention Deficit Ep. 6 – Sixteen Adversarial Reviewers
episodes.description: A $3,000 token day, Claude gets $534 to trade, Anthropic marks its text, and a Bash harness that knows when it’s time to go to sleep.
